meta.title: Bilibili uploader downloader
meta.description: Adds a Bilibili downloader panel to the sidebar: enter an uploader UID, choose a quality and a destination folder, then download every video on that uploader's page with per-video progress. A video link can also be downloaded on its own. Videos that share a title get a BV suffix so a different video is never mistaken for an existing file. Listing the videos and higher qualities such as 1080P need a signed-in cookie (SESSDATA); the ffmpeg that DASH merging needs is downloaded automatically on first use and can also be set manually.
